purpose: Exploratory quality gate by the current conversation assistant; not a formal model benchmark
selection_order: Sort each requested stratum by SHA256(seed_string + ':' + dataset_name + ':' + source_question_id), take fixed counts below; no replacement based on answers or performance
input_allowlist: Question, ordinary context, options where applicable, source paragraph indices/titles. No answers, gold evidence, decomposition, explanations, validation votes, or supporting flags.
tools: Local reading/search within supplied contexts allowed. No internet answer lookup or other agents solving sampled questions.
commitment: Save all 20 predictions with concise evidence and uncertainty before reading any sample gold answers; record SHA256 and UTC time before scoring.
scoring: Multiple choice exact option match; MuSiQue normalized exact match and token F1 against provided answer and aliases. Missing answers remain wrong; ambiguous questions retained in denominator and separately flagged.
contamination_disclosure: Research papers and dataset documentation were consulted beforehand and may show examples. Public material may also occur in pretraining. Record any noticed sample overlap; this is not a contamination-free evaluation.
model: Current conversation assistant; exact backend model ID unverified
